scope: AUTHORED_PROTOCOL_FIXTURE with real temporary SQLite and authored bytes; no model training, native inference or operator labels

mechanism.mirror: Atomic filesystem replacement under SQLite write lock; interrupted pre-commit publication reconciles from committed registry on construction
mechanism.recovery: PENDING_USER, no automatic candidate activation; explicit approve retry required
mechanism.candidate_binding: Intent hashes trainer, items, request, drift, gate and base generation; a competing input edit aborts before activation.
mechanism.live_intent_serialization: Shared Store mutex covers both approval transactions and recovery; Store coordinator flock excludes a second Store owner.

limitations: Filesystem mirror and SQLite are separate durability domains; ACTIVATING journal provides recovery rather than claiming an indivisible cross-filesystem transaction.
Recovery failure propagates and retains ACTIVATING; no APPROVED/consolidated claim is made.
Authored trainers without deployed metadata retain approval-only behavior; this is not proof that they activated an adapter.
No semantic learning benefit or phone proof is established.

Filesystem-only runner readers do not acquire the Store mutex or require an idle Runtime during :growth approve. An actual concurrent reader observed candidate args before a later SQLite COMMIT failure; reader/coordinator serialization remains open. See reader-concurrency-report.json.
verification_note: An earlier tool command reported exit 0 but its log lacked the unittest footer; that incomplete log is preserved without inferring a cause. The separate review-tests.log rerun has the actual 68-tests/OK footer.
